notes: Random flight records at 0x1d0000 (kinds 0..3, 9..12 and random) whose 25-byte point table at 0x1d1000 is prefilled with random bytes; outbound and return paths with 0..12 random points and sometimes negative counts; in 25% of the cases the return path is null and its count/pointer are read from address 0. Stack arguments are random with skip-first 0/1/0x100 and return-direct 0/1/2/0x101 patterns.
